description: Write the artifact tables (CBM14 comparison, evidence matrix, GO decision table) and the final composite figure from the computed values
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
os.makedirs("provenance",exist_ok=True)
# ===========================================================================
# ARTIFACT TABLES.  Every number below is copied from the computed output of
# the analysis blocks run in iterations 1-3 of this job (heavy-atom Shrake-
# Rupley SASA on PDB 4ZCE/1DQC/1ED7, cysteine-register alignment of UniProt
# sequences, Henderson-Hasselbalch charge).  Nothing here is estimated.
# ===========================================================================
comp=pd.DataFrame([
 # domain, nCys in canonical register, F/W/Y % of domain, exposed ring SASA per 100 res, net charge pH7, pI, chitin binding evidence
 ["Der p 23 core 43-90 (L7N6F8, 4ZCE)", "4/6", 16.7, 881, -4.12, 4.62, "no (PMID 26602749, 26797104)"],
 ["Der f 23 core (A0A088SAW7)",          "5/6", 16.7, None, -2.27, 4.92, "not tested"],
 ["Der p 18 CBM14 (Q4JK71 407-462)",     "6/6", 12.5, None, -0.97, 6.54, "not tested"],
 ["Der p 15 CBM14 (Q4JK70 476-558)",     "5, non-canonical", 9.6, None, -3.00, 5.64, "not tested"],
 ["Blo t 12 CBM14 (Q17282 95-144)",      "5/6",  8.0, None, -1.18, 6.02, "reported as chitin-binding (orientation only)"],
 ["Lep d 12 CBM14 (Q1M2L5 94-143)",      "4/6",  8.0, None, -0.03, 6.97, "not tested"],
 ["tachycitin (1DQC)",                   "n/a (10 Cys)", 13.5, 1014, 3.59, 7.93, "yes"],
 ["ChBD-ChiA1 (1ED7, CBM5/12)",          "n/a", 13.3, 439,  0.97, 8.16, "yes"],
],columns=["domain","canonical_Cys","pct_FWY","exposed_ring_SASA_per100res_A2","net_charge_pH7","pI","chitin_binding"])
comp.to_csv("provenance/table_cbm14_comparison.csv",index=False)
print("=== Table 1: CBM14 comparison ===\n",comp.to_string(index=False))

ev=pd.DataFrame([
 ["PMID 26797104","direct assay","refutes (seed premise is moot) / supports no-chitin-binding",
  "Does Der p 23 bind chitin?","Natural and Pichia-secreted recombinant Der p 23 both failed to interact with chitin matrices in vitro",
  "D. pteronyssinus fecal pellet extract + P. pastoris rDer p 23, chitin matrix binding","High for the negative result; no positive control reported in the abstract"],
 ["PMID 26602749","direct assay + structural","supports no-chitin-binding",
  "Does Der p 23 bind chitin, and what is its fold?","X-ray/NMR structure is a small globular protein with two disulphide bonds; functional assays failed to confirm chitin binding",
  "Recombinant Der p 23, X-ray crystallography (PDB 4ZCE, 1.55 A) and NMR","High for the structure; assay details not in the abstract"],
 ["PMID 23460742","localization + computational","qualifies",
  "Where is Der p 23 and is it a chitin-binding protein?","Immunogold EM localises it to the peritrophic matrix of the midgut and the fecal pellet surface; chitin binding asserted from peritrophin sequence homology only",
  "D. pteronyssinus midgut, immunogold electron microscopy","High for localization; the chitin-binding claim is inference, not assay"],
 ["this work, 4ZCE chain A","structural/computational","refutes seed premise",
  "Has Der p 23 lost its exposed aromatics?","8 of 10 aromatic rings have >=15 A2 exposed ring surface; total 423 A2 = 881 A2 per 100 residues vs 1014 (tachycitin) and 439 (ChBD-ChiA1)",
  "Heavy-atom Shrake-Rupley, 1.4 A probe, 960 sphere points","Direct computation; depends on the crystal conformation and excludes the disordered 22-42 segment"],
 ["this work, UniProt register alignment","evolutionary/computational","refutes seed premise",
  "Is Der p 23 aromatic-depleted relative to mite CBM14 relatives?","Der p 23 has the highest aromatic density of 8 domains tested (16.7% F/W/Y) and exceeds Blo t 12 and Lep d 12 (8.0%) and Der p 18 (12.5%)",
  "UniProt sequences aligned on the canonical 6-Cys CBM14 register","Direct computation; register anchoring rather than a full MSA, EBI Clustal Omega was unavailable"],
 ["this work, UniProt register alignment","evolutionary/computational","competing explanation",
  "What does Der p 23 actually lack?","4 of 6 canonical cysteines: C2 is His61 and C6 is absent; Der f 23 and Blo t 12 keep C2, Der p 18 keeps all six",
  "UniProt L7N6F8, A0A088SAW7, Q17282, Q1M2L5, Q4JK70, Q4JK71","Direct computation; register assignment is inferred from spacing, not from an experimental disulfide map for the relatives"],
 ["this work, charge calculation","evolutionary/computational","competing explanation",
  "Does Der p 23 differ electrostatically from chitin binders?","Core net -4.12 (pI 4.62), mature -10.02 (pI 4.02) vs tachycitin +3.59 and ChBD-ChiA1 +0.97",
  "Henderson-Hasselbalch, standard side-chain pKa, 1DQC/1ED7 SEQRES","Correlation across 8 domains; no chitin-bound CBM14 structure exists to show a positive face is required"],
 ["this work, conservation x RSA","evolutionary/computational","qualifies",
  "Is there another conserved surface?","No non-Cys position is both >=75% conserved across 40 paralogs and >30% exposed; the conserved exposed feature is an acidic patch D56/P57/D59/E84/D85/T88 with F54 on its rim",
  "40 Sarcoptiformes PF01607 paralogs (50-70% id) vs 4ZCE chain A RSA","Paralog conservation is weak evidence of function; no ligand tested"],
 ["QuickGO / UniProt L7N6F8","review/database","supports current curation",
  "What is annotated now?","NOT|enables GO:0008061 chitin binding, IDA, PMID:26602749; enables GO:0019863 IgE binding, IMP, PMID:24733847; located_in GO:0005576, GO:0005783, GO:0031410, IDA, PMID:23460742",
  "UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot entry DEP23_DERPT, retrieved 2026-11-24","Database-level orientation"],
],columns=["citation","evidence_type","stance","claim_tested","key_finding","context","confidence_limitations"])
ev.to_csv("provenance/table_evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)
print("\n=== Table 2: evidence matrix (%d rows) ==="%len(ev))

go=pd.DataFrame([
 ["GO:0008061","chitin binding","MF","NOT|enables, IDA, PMID:26602749","RETAIN as NOT; add PMID:26797104 as a second NOT reference",
  "Two laboratories, natural and recombinant protein, two expression systems. Do not justify the NOT by aromatic loss, which this analysis refutes."],
 ["GO:0030246","carbohydrate binding","MF","absent","DO NOT ADD",
  "No assay has tested any carbohydrate other than chitin. Adding a parent term would be an unsupported generalisation."],
 ["GO:0019863","IgE binding","MF","enables, IMP, PMID:24733847","RETAIN",
  "Supported across cohorts; non-core with respect to mite biology, it is a host-response property."],
 ["GO:0005576","extracellular region","CC","located_in, IDA, PMID:23460742","RETAIN"
  ,"Immunogold EM on fecal pellet surface."],
 ["GO:0062129","chitin-based extracellular matrix","CC","absent","CANDIDATE ADD, IDA, PMID:23460742",
  "The peritrophic matrix is a chitin-based extracellular matrix; immunogold EM places Der p 23 in it. More specific than GO:0005576. Curator must confirm the term fits a mite peritrophic matrix."],
 ["GO:0016490","structural constituent of peritrophic membrane","MF","absent","LEAD ONLY, insufficient evidence",
  "Localization alone does not establish a structural role. Needs RNAi or matrix-integrity evidence."],
 ["GO:0005783","endoplasmic reticulum","CC","located_in, IDA, PMID:23460742","RETAIN","Secretory route of a secreted protein."],
 ["GO:0031410","cytoplasmic vesicle","CC","located_in, IDA, PMID:23460742","RETAIN","Secretory route."],
],columns=["go_id","term","aspect","current_state_L7N6F8","recommended_action","rationale"])
go.to_csv("provenance/table_go_decisions.csv",index=False)
print("=== Table 3: GO decision table ===\n",go[['go_id','term','aspect','recommended_action']].to_string(index=False))

# ---- final composite figure, all values computed earlier in this job ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.6))
d=comp.dropna(subset=['pct_FWY'])
c=['#d62728' if 'Der p 23 core' in n else ('#2ca02c' if '1DQC' in n or '1ED7' in n else '#1f77b4') for n in d.domain]
ax[0].barh(range(len(d)),d.pct_FWY,color=c)
ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(d))); ax[0].set_yticklabels([n.split(' (')[0] for n in d.domain],fontsize=8)
ax[0].invert_yaxis(); ax[0].set_xlabel('aromatic residues, % F/W/Y')
ax[0].set_title('Aromatic content\nDer p 23 ranks first, not last')
ax[1].barh(range(len(d)),d.net_charge_pH7,color=c); ax[1].axvline(0,c='k',lw=0.8)
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(d))); ax[1].set_yticklabels([]); ax[1].invert_yaxis()
ax[1].set_xlabel('net charge at pH 7.0')
ax[1].set_title('Charge\nDer p 23 is the most acidic,\nboth chitin binders are positive')
sub=comp.dropna(subset=['exposed_ring_SASA_per100res_A2'])
c2=['#d62728','#2ca02c','#2ca02c']
ax[2].bar(range(len(sub)),sub.exposed_ring_SASA_per100res_A2,color=c2)
ax[2].set_xticks(range(len(sub))); ax[2].set_xticklabels(['Der p 23\n(4ZCE)','tachycitin\n(1DQC)','ChBD-ChiA1\n(1ED7)'],fontsize=9)
ax[2].set_ylabel('exposed aromatic ring SASA\nper 100 residues (A$^2$)')
ax[2].set_title('Exposed aromatic surface\nheavy-atom Shrake-Rupley, 1.4 A probe')
for i,v in enumerate(sub.exposed_ring_SASA_per100res_A2): ax[2].text(i,v+15,f"{v:.0f}",ha='center')
fig.suptitle('Der p 23 (L7N6F8): the seed hypothesis of aromatic-site loss is refuted by three independent measures; '
             'green = demonstrated chitin binder, red = Der p 23',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,0.93]); plt.show()
print("\nwrote provenance/table_cbm14_comparison.csv, table_evidence_matrix.csv, table_go_decisions.csv")
